Input Group

Input groups extend form inputs by prepending or appending text, buttons, icons, and dropdowns to create richer input experiences.

Text Addons

Prepend or append static text to inputs.

@
.00
https:// .com
HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">@</span>
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="username">
</div>

<div class="zak-input-group">
  <input type="number" class="zak-input" placeholder="0.00">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">.00</span>
</div>

<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">https://</span>
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="example.com">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">.com</span>
</div>

Button Addons

Attach buttons to inputs for actions.

HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <input type="search" class="zak-input" placeholder="Search...">
  <button type="submit" class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Search</button>
</div>

<div class="zak-input-group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Subscribe</button>
  <input type="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="your@email.com">
</div>

Icon Addons

Use icons in input groups for visual context.

HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <rect width="20" height="16" x="2" y="4" rx="2"/><path d="m22 7-8.97 5.7a1.94 1.94 0 0 1-2.06 0L2 7"/>
    </svg>
  </span>
  <input type="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="you@example.com">
</div>

Multiple Addons

Combine multiple addons on both sides.

USD
HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">$</span>
  <input type="number" class="zak-input" placeholder="0.00">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">USD</span>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Convert</button>
</div>

Sizing

Input groups support small and large sizes.

SM
Default
LG
HTML 
<div class="zak-input-group zak-input-group-sm">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">SM</span>
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Small">
</div>

<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">Default</span>
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Default">
</div>

<div class="zak-input-group zak-input-group-lg">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">LG</span>
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Large">
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-input-groupBase input group container
.zak-input-group-smSmall size
.zak-input-group-lgLarge size
.zak-input-group-textAddon text element

Accessibility

  • Ensure the input within the group still has an associated <label>.
  • Addons should not interfere with keyboard navigation through the input.
  • Use aria-label on icon-only buttons within input groups.
  • Form validation messages should be linked to the input via aria-describedby.
